description: Mark the secret map values sensitive, so they accept `Redacted` and never print in logs or errors. The spec marks every secret value `format: password, writeOnly: true, x-sensitive: true`, but the converter carries the mark only to named members (`value` of PUT /v1/apps/{project}/secrets/{name} is already `Redacted`), not to the values of an `additionalProperties` map: the `set` map of PATCH /v1/apps/{project}/secrets (patchSecrets) and of `secrets_patch`, and the `secrets` map of PUT /v1/apps/{project} (putApp). The spec's own descriptions: "Per-app secrets. Names can be listed, values never come back", and "Secrets are not allowed in a build's `spec` (it is stored in plain text)".
